title: Strategic Autonomy in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
summary_en: This essay argues that the rapid advance of AI will frustrate ambitions for strategic autonomy.
title_cn: Strategic Autonomy in the Age of Artificial Intelligence

title: AI as Strategist: Four Hypotheses on the Nature of Agentic Strategy
summary_en: In this chapter, the author considers a radical future, a world in which nations pursue relative advantage, for national security, and for other national objectives guided by AI models that are mostly playing these strategy games against other models.
title_cn: AI as Strategist: Four Hypotheses on the Nature of Agentic Strategy

title: Bilateral AI Partnerships Alone Won't Secure Australia. Here’s a Multilateral Alternative
summary_en: Australia's answer to regional AI collaboration lies in federated learning, an AI model that allows cross-border collaboration on transnational security issues whilst preserving data sovereignty.
title_cn: Bilateral AI Partnerships Alone Won't Secure Australia. Here’s a Multilateral Alternative

title: Artificial Intelligence and the Risk of Strategic Cyberattack
summary_en: The author argues that agentic artificial intelligence will alleviate the key constraints on cyber operations and may unlock strategic potential in cyber weapons that has, until now, remained largely theoretical.
title_cn: Artificial Intelligence and the Risk of Strategic Cyberattack

title: Technical Documentation for the Thirteenth American School District Panel Survey
summary_en: This report provides technical information about the spring 2026 survey of the American School District Panel. The authors describe the survey administration and weighting processes they used to produce nationally representative estimates.
title_cn: Technical Documentation for the Thirteenth American School District Panel Survey

title: Shrinking Budgets, Fewer Students: How District Leaders are Navigating a New Landscape of Reduced Resources and Competitive Pressures
summary_en: This report presents findings from the spring 2026 American School District Panel survey. Budget shortfalls and declining enrollment have risen to the top of district leaders’ concerns, worsening other challenges that districts are facing.
title_cn: Shrinking Budgets, Fewer Students: How District Leaders are Navigating a New Landscape of Reduced Resources and Competitive Pressures
